mechanism: Store primary PC/PI/PIM head hints in16 bits as well as predecessor hints. Reconstruct low16-bit coordinate at lookup and check bounds before byte probe; retain valid distance checks.
difference_from_old_work: R20 only narrowed predecessors; full-width heads remained. This reduces the principal table footprint and initialization, with a real reconstruction cost and possible hint semantic changes. Lean types are unadapted draft; no correctness claim.

attribution.inherited_router: Existing length/content routes retained without new benchmark identity rule.
